rationale: Turkish abbreviates minute as "dk"; a bare "D" is ambiguous (commonly read as "dakika" only in this context) and the 2-character limit allows "dk".

rationale: This is a content description read aloud; the source word "versus" conveys the matchup and is lost as a silent hyphen.
